GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back (tearaway leader) to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, drifted back to last (margin decreased as leader/2nd came right back) in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated she was required to continually urge it along early/middle stages to hold a handy position behind a genuine tempo, was under full pressure when the field started to improve at 600m and ground its way to the line. She added it was down in distance and raced in a manner suggesting it would appreciate a step back up in distance. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # needs further
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding app stated that she was required to continually encourage her mount along in the early and middle stages to hold a handy position behind a genuine tempo. App stated that when the field commenced to improve passing the 600m her mount was under full pressure and it ground its way to the line. App stated her mount was down in distance today and it raced in a manner that suggests it would appreciate a step back up in distance. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
